Title: Change of Target vs Unleash Hell's Fury

Messages.Author: jhattara
Messages.Body:
1) Does the Unleash Hell's Fury inflict 1 aggravated damage and is burned before Change of Target is played?

2) Can the acting vampire play Change of Target after being blocked successfully by the Unleash Hell's Fury?

My guess:
1) yes
2) no

Name: Change of Target
[Jyhad:U, VTES:U, CE:U, Anarchs:PAB2, LoB:PG2/PI2, KoT:U/PM3]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Only usable when this acting minion is blocked (play before combat, if any). Untap the acting minion, do not tap the blocking minion, and end the current action (it is not successful). This minion cannot perform the same action again this turn.

Name: Unleash Hell's Fury
[HttB:R]
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 2 pool
Discipline: Daimoinon
Burn Option
+1 stealth action. Requires an infernal vampire. Unique.
[dai] Put this card in play. This card may attempt to block a  action against you and is considered a 9-capacity infernal vampire with +2 intercept during that attempt; if successful, the acting minion takes 1 unpreventable aggravated damage, and this card is burned.
[DAI] As above, and untap this vampire.

Jussi Hattara
Webmaster Extraordinaire
Finnish  Politics!

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Yes and yes.
Since you're blocked and the block isn't canceled, UHF triggers.

And since the action is not finished (even if you're in torpor), you can play action modifiers, including CoT since you're blocked.
